tasks.title: Materialize new-module contract baseline and shared synthetic fixtures
outputs: single root go.mod/go.sum with pinned allowed libraries
minimal composition signatures and source licensing/provenance
acceptance: Contract package compiles with standard library only.
No product implementation from legacy root/bootstrap is transplanted.
Interfaces match normative contract; every shared file has one writer.

tasks.title: Implement task service, hierarchy/lifecycle and retained DAG/plan DSL
inputs: contract interfaces and synthetic Repository fake
outputs: internal/query Parser/selectors with exact operation allowlist
deterministic phases/path, SCC and dependency diagnostics
acceptance: A,B block C; C blocks D gives [A,B],[C],[D] and lexical [A,C,D] regardless of estimates.
Missing/active out-of-scope/cycle diagnostics never produce usable phases.
Status/estimate/assignee/terminal-ancestor/reparent guards; forbidden runtime fields/operations fail with zero writes.
Callback computes changes against transaction snapshot; no nested repository or I/O.

tasks.title: Implement transactional single backend and authenticated HTTP boundary
acceptance: Two CAS writers at N yield one N+1 and one 412; injected edge/import failure and process death expose all or none.
One consistent read revision, restart persistence, unknown-schema readiness refusal, isolated consistent backup/restore.
Missing/disabled/revoked/expired/wrong-project credentials fail; viewer cannot write; no ambient account or proxy identity.
No configured Authorizer means no listener; synthetic fixture mode is literal-loopback only.

tasks.title: Implement one HTTP client and product CLI with injected config/auth seams
inputs: frozen wire envelopes/routes/DSL and httptest fake service
explicit synthetic projection + credential fd adapter
outputs: internal/platform narrow local seams, no claimed upstream implementation
acceptance: Loopback and verified-TLS httptest produce equivalent facts/plans.
Projection/credential/contract/account mismatch fails before mutation; no ambient env/config/board filesystem.
If-Match auto read or explicit override, 412 is not retried; unknown write outcome returns nonzero for read/reconcile.
Errors map to prescribed exits, no HTTP200 in-band failure accepted, no credential logging or redirect forwarding.

tasks.title: Implement bounded sanitized import/native export conversion
inputs: synthetic legacy-v2 and native-v1 archives only
outputs: synthetic field/exclusion/roundtrip and malicious archive fixtures
acceptance: No DB writes in Prepare; preserve text/ID/estimate distinction/edges/resources and inert sanitized activity provenance.
Digest/manifest/duplicate/unknown field/version/parent/cycle errors and malformed archive/limits reject before commit.
Unsupported resources/unknown meaningful content block instead of drop; exclusions are exact and commit requires consent.
Roundtrip preserves facts/graph; importing archive revision never overwrites target revision or grants.

tasks.title: Compose and qualify synthetic MVP with one integrated acceptance report
outputs: cmd binaries wired to concrete local interfaces
build/test logs, source extraction attribution and release candidate artifact
acceptance: GOMAXPROCS=2 go test -p 2 ./...; targeted race/CAS/fault/restart tests where meaningful.
Real process-kill/reopen transaction witness and separate backup restore proof, no merely mutex-based atomicity claim.
Actual CLI/service synthetic loopback docking plus verified-TLS test adapter coverage.
No source edits, secrets, runtime/provider calls, subprocess spawning, public/unprotected server, production adoption claim or review verdict.

acceptance: No Codex independent review ACCEPT and no owner-identity signing.

tasks.title: Adopt production adapter and authorized sanitized real snapshot; controlled dogfood/cutover
inputs: U1 owning repository/pin/accepted configurator/auth contract and reviewed adapter
outputs: new-project atomic import + backup/restore + rollback reconciliation
acceptance: Synthetic fixtures never count as production authorization.
Source untouched until owner-authorized cutover; avoid dual writes and stale-board rollback.

critical_path.metric: unweighted dependency edges, not elapsed time

parallel_release: After P0 shared contracts, release P1/P2/P3/P4 together, each with own isolated clone and interface fakes; no producer waits for another implementation. Orchestrator alone staffs/registers/launches.
deferred_followup: New product skill after accepted interface/dogfood; no copied legacy usage instructions or artificial task inflation.
